assets.purpose: Desktop landing page hero; title, subtitle and CTA overlay on cream left
assets.alt: A spectacled mouse teacher shares a blank book with a golden Chow dog and striped cat in a welcoming paper-textured Chinese village garden.
assets.crop_rules: Use full 3:2 frame. Prefer contain or native aspect ratio. Do not center-crop to portrait; switch to mobile hero. Avoid text beyond x=0.33, as dog's tail enters around x=0.35.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE new polished 3:2 landscape landing-page hero illustration for Laoshu Laoshi, a welcoming immersive language-learning world. The input style board is style reference only; three input character sheets establish the cast's exact identities, never reproduce their sheet layouts. This scene is a Chinese storybook garden outside the village, not anyone's personal room. Composition: LEFT 40% is quiet warm cream handmade paper with only extremely pale sparse atmospheric washes, clean enough for real app title, subtitle and buttons to be placed over it. No foreground subjects or strong edges there. All action in RIGHT 55%: the mouse teacher in blue robe and round glasses presents a large open blank cream book to his friendly golden Chow dog and striped Lihua cat companions. The three full-bodied friends gather close in a welcoming semicircle, every head, ear, tail and foot fully within frame. Mouse center of group, dog beside him, cat beside him; identities and proportions match sheets. Small charming cottages with jade and indigo tiled roofs visible behind the group on the right, garden stepping stones, restrained bamboo and pink blossoms framing far right and upper right; generous breathing room, no clutter. Soft daylight, warm invitation to explore stories. Fade gently from richly colored right garden to quiet cream left, without a hard dividing line. Flat gouache and folk woodblock shapes on handmade paper, following the supplied D Story Garden + Paper Detail board for palette and medium only. Warm cream, indigo, muted jade, terracotta and restrained ochre; painted paper details, imperfect cut edges, fine paper grain, shallow soft layer shadows, soft daylight. No photorealism, no glossy 3D, no vector look. Character identity strictly follows supplied approved character sheets: tan mouse teacher with pink ears, round glasses and long blue Chinese robe; golden fluffy Chow with blue vest and ochre toggles; brown/gold striped Lihua cat with white muzzle/paws and dark vest with red and gold trim. Whole expressive faces, friendly natural interaction, same scale and proportions as character sheets. No writing, letters, numbers, symbols resembling text, labels, watermarks, frames, panels or interface. All books and signs blank.
assets.validation: Inspected full image: correct cast, clothing, warm paper/gouache style, blank book where applicable, no text or baked UI, intact full bodies and faces. This art is for public landing and onboarding only; not personal home room.
assets.coordinate_system: normalized image coordinates, origin upper left
